about_the_game:
The Anubis Treasure
Explore, solve puzzles, and discover hidden secrets in this 2D adventure inspired by the ancient pyramids of Egypt.

Immerse Yourself in a World of Mystery and Adventure
Egypt holds a great secret: The Anubis Treasure, a legendary relic that has remained hidden for centuries. In this 2D platforming adventure, you take on the role of a young archaeologist who, after failing in his first expeditions, receives one last chance to prove his worth.

To reach the Great Gate, you must find the 9 sacred keys while avoiding deadly traps, solving puzzles, and exploring temples filled with secrets. But be careful... you are not alone in this quest.

Technical Data Sheet

  • Genre: Adventure / 2D Platformer / Puzzles

  • Languages: English, Spanish

  • Players: 1 (OFFLINE)

  • Difficulty:

    • Gameplay: Easy

    • Exploration: Medium

    • Puzzles: Medium - Difficult

Visual Style: 2D with minimalist graphics

Main Features

  • Main Objective: Find the 9 sacred keys to access The Anubis Treasure.

  • Exploration & Puzzles: Avoid traps, activate mechanisms, and solve riddles to progress.

  • Internal Achievement System: 30 achievements waiting to challenge your skills.

Collectibles:

  • 3 special coins in each level for total exploration.

  • 16 hidden Egyptian busts inside the pyramids.

  • 25 secret treasures scattered across the levels.

Side Quests:

  • Gather 3 scarab charms for the photographer.

  • Find the secret boomerang.

  • Discover the Book of Anum, an item with mysterious information.

4 Different Endings: Based on your progress and collected items, without restarting the game.

Levels & Duration: 36 levels + sublevels, estimated playtime between 4 and 15 hours. (++)
Original Soundtrack created by NOAH Digital Developer.

Gameplay: Platforming, exploration, stealth, and puzzles.

Music
Immerse yourself in the mystical atmosphere of ancient Egypt with an original soundtrack composed exclusively for the game. With over 41 unique musical pieces, it blends traditional Egyptian instruments with modern arrangements, creating a one-of-a-kind experience that will accompany you through every discovery, puzzle, and challenge.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card with WDDM 1.0 driver
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound device
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, keyboard or gamepad recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Tarjeta gráfica compatible con DirectX 11 o posterior con controlador WDDM 1.0.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound device
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, keyboard or gamepad recommended
